components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--color-primary, #12676E); color: var(--color-primary-foreground, #fff); font: 500 17px/1 Mukta, 'Noto Sans Devanagari', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-primary, #12676E) 90%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-ring, #12676E) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--color-input, #CFC9BE); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--color-background, #fff); color: var(--color-foreground, #17181F); font: 500 17px/1 Mukta, 'Noto Sans Devanagari', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .15s, color .15s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--color-secondary, #EEF6F5); color: var(--color-secondary-foreground, #0B3D42); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-ring, #12676E) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: CustomInput field: 44px, white, warm stroke, teal focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; font-family: Mukta, 'Noto Sans Devanagari', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--color-foreground, #17181F); } .ds-req { color: var(--color-destructive, #C62828); } .ds-input { display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--color-input, #CFC9BE); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--color-background, #fff); } .ds-input:focus-within { border-color: var(--color-ring, #12676E); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-ring, #12676E) 40%, transparent); } .ds-input input { height: 44px; width: 100%; border: none; outline: none; background: transparent; font: 400 17px Mukta, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--color-foreground, #17181F); } .ds-input input::placeholder { color: var(--color-muted-foreground, #5E5A54); }

components.name: Top Header
components.description: Teal band, 64px. Active link is white with a pale copper (accent-30) bar on the band's bottom edge.
components.html: Ayurveda AIDashboardPatientsAI summary
components.css: .ds-band { display: flex; align-items: center; height: 64px; padding: 0 24px; gap: 0; background: var(--color-shell, #0E4F55); color: var(--color-shell-foreground, #E6F0EF); font-family: Mukta, 'Noto Sans Devanagari', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-band-brand { font-weight: 600; color: #fff; margin-right: 32px; } .ds-band-item { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 64px; padding: 0 16px; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 500; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-shell-foreground, #E6F0EF) 85%, transparent); text-decoration: none; transition: background-color .15s, color .15s; } .ds-band-item:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.1); color: #fff; } .ds-band-item:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--color-shell-foreground, #E6F0EF); } .ds-band-item[aria-current=page] { color: #fff; font-weight: 600; } .ds-band-item[aria-current=page]::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 16px; right: 16px; bottom: 0; height: 3px; border-radius: 2px 2px 0 0; background: var(--color-accent-30, #D99D6E); }

components.name: Page Header
components.description: Copper bar, title, one-line description, primary action right. The copper bar is the signature 'you are here' mark.
components.css: .ds-ph { padding: 24px; background: var(--color-page, #FBFAF7); font-family: Mukta, 'Noto Sans Devanagari', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-ph-bar { display: block; width: 32px; height: 3px; margin-bottom: 12px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-accent, #B8662E); } .ds-ph h1 { margin: 0; font-size: 30px; line-height: 1.25; font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-foreground, #17181F); } .ds-ph p { margin: 4px 0 0; font-size: 15px; line-height: 22px; color: var(--color-muted-foreground, #5E5A54); }

narrative.northStar: The Copper Vessel and Its Patina
narrative.overview:
A deep verdigris teal holds the shell and every action, the way patina holds an old copper lota; a thin copper bar marks where you are. The world is Ayurvedic in material (teal, copper, warm white, an amphora mark) and modern in behaviour: flat, bordered, dense enough for a register, and read at a glance mid-consultation in a daylit clinic.

The screen is built in three layers: a full-width teal band at the top (brand, nav, user), a warm-white page canvas, and white bordered cards that carry the work. Colour is spent on actions and orientation, never on content surfaces. Red is held back so that when it appears it means a red flag or an error. The world refuses generic wellness green and grey SaaS with one blue accent.
keyCharacteristics: Deep teal band (64px) as the top bar; no sidebar.
Teal for buttons, links, focus rings, selection and selected tints.
A 3px copper bar that marks the current place and nothing else.
Warm-white page, white cards, warm hairlines, near-black ink.
Mukta for Latin and Devanagari together; body steps up to 15px.
Borders over shadows; shadows only on floating layers.

rules.name: The Copper Bar Rule
rules.body: Copper marks the current place only: the active nav item, the page title, and summary section heads, as a 3px bar. Never a fill, pill, badge, border, icon or text colour.

rules.name: The Band Contrast Rule
rules.body: On the teal band, copper is `accent-30`, not `accent`. Anything light on the band uses `shell-foreground`, `shell-muted` or white.

rules.name: The Reserved Red Rule
rules.body: Red appears only for red flags and errors (and destructive actions). If a screen shows red, something needs the vaidya's attention.

rules.name: The Paper and Card Rule
rules.body: The page canvas is `bg-page` warm white; every working surface (`bg-background`, `bg-card`) is pure white on top of it. Never put content directly on a tinted fill.

rules.name: The Tokens Only Rule
rules.body: No raw hex, no Tailwind palette classes (`text-green-700`), no inline colours in components. A colour change happens in `index.css` only. No dark mode yet.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Mukta for Latin and Devanagari together; never introduce a second family or a separate Devanagari face for display.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: All UI copy is sentence case ("Add patient", "AI summary"). Uppercase is reserved for table column headers.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: IDs, Reg. Nos., ages, times, dates and counts use `tabular-nums`.

rules.name: The Borders Over Shadows Rule
rules.body: Cards and panels are `border border-border bg-card` with no shadow. Shadows belong to things that float above the page.

dos: Do use the copper bar only through `PageHeader`, `SummarySection` and the nav components.
Do use `accent-30` for copper on the teal band.
Do show allergies as amber caution pills with the drawn alert icon.
Do keep content on white cards over the `bg-page` canvas.
Do use `tabular-nums` for IDs, ages, times, dates and counts.
Do keep copy short and sentence case ("Add patient", not "ADD NEW PATIENT").
Do reuse a `_reference/` pattern (e.g. a list page with drawer) by re-creating it with Ayurveda AI data.
donts: Don't use copper as a fill, pill, badge, border or text colour.
Don't use red for anything but red flags, errors and delete.
Don't use the bar shape or copper for warnings; warnings stay amber tint pills.
Don't put shadows on cards or panels.
Don't invent one-off components, colours, spacings or shadows; no raw hex or palette classes.
Don't put business logic in pages; hooks in `features/<x>/hooks`, helpers in `src/utils`.
